question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The blank No. 2 in the passage needs an adverb to describe the frequency of forest fires in summer.
 
• "Often" is the most appropriate choice as it indicates a frequent occurrence, which aligns with the context of forest fires happening regularly during summers.
 
• Other options like "hardly," "rarely," and "seldom" suggest infrequency, which contradicts the idea of frequent forest fires described in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Hardly (मुश्किल से): "Hardly" means rarely or barely, which contradicts the idea of frequent forest fires.
 
• Rarely (कभी-कभार): "Rarely" suggests infrequency, which does not fit the passage’s context of frequent forest fires.
 
• Seldom (कभी-कभार): "Seldom" also implies infrequency and is unsuitable for describing the regular occurrence of forest fires.
